---
title: "IS-översikt"
format:
  dashboard:
    theme: default
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
library(readr)
library(plotly)
library(DT)

stats <- read_tsv("../results/tables/genome_stats.tsv", show_col_types = FALSE)

colors <- c(
  paper = "#fde68a",
  Richelia = "#bfdbfe",
  Frankia = "#bbf7d0",
  test = "#e5e7eb",
  endobiont = "#ddd6fe",
  periplasmisk = "#fecaca"
)

badge <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(x) || !nzchar(x)) return("")
  parts <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(x, ",")))
  paste0(vapply(parts, function(p) {
    bg <- if (p %in% names(colors)) colors[[p]] else "#e5e7eb"
    sprintf(
      '<span style="display:inline-block;padding:1px 7px;margin:0 2px 2px 0;border-radius:999px;font-size:0.75rem;background:%s;">%s</span>',
      bg, htmltools::htmlEscape(p)
    )
  }, ""), collapse = " ")
}

if (!"tags" %in% names(stats)) stats$tags <- ""
stats$tag_html <- vapply(stats$tags, badge, character(1))
```

## Rad {height="20%"}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Genom"
list(value = nrow(stats))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Median % IS"
list(value = round(median(stats$pct_genome_is, na.rm = TRUE), 2))
```

## Rad

```{r}
#| title: "Genomstorlek mot andel IS"
plot_ly(
  stats,
  x = ~genome_bp / 1e6,
  y = ~pct_genome_is,
  color = ~assembly_level,
  text = ~paste(sample, organism_name, tags, top_family, sep = "<br>"),
  hoverinfo = "text",
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "markers"
) |>
  layout(xaxis = list(title = "Genom (Mbp)"), yaxis = list(title = "% IS"))
```

## Rad

```{r}
#| title: "Klickbar tabell"
datatable(
  stats[, c("sample", "organism_name", "tag_html", "assembly_level",
            "genome_bp", "n_contigs", "n50", "n_is", "n_complete",
            "n_partial", "pct_genome_is", "top_family")],
  escape = FALSE,
  colnames = c("sample", "organism", "taggar", "nivå", "bp",
               "contigs", "N50", "IS", "c", "p", "% IS", "toppfamilj"),
  options = list(pageLength = 15),
  filter = "top"
)
```
